en: Who would listen... to anything you say...
Remember... when the couple who raised you were killed...
When your master became one of the dead and attacked you...
What did you feel?
...Ngh... Raaaaaaaaaah...!!
Yes, Clive... that is the cry of your blood...
Raaaaaaaaaah...!!
Hahahahahahaha!!!! Yes, the Prince of Darkness is born!!! Hahahaha.
Do you see now, angel? Your justice means nothing before our blood!
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!!
So you have come...
This is the end, Ravenruft.
Today I finish all of it.
The end... what a pleasant ring that word has.
If you choose a finite life, then so be it.
I shall bury you with my own hands.
Welcome, Clive. I have been waiting.
Ravenruft... before I kill you, there's one thing I want to ask.
You were a hero once. Why did you give in to the dragon's blood...?
Heh, to think I would hear such words from you...
But it is a foolish question.
You must feel it too... the boundless power welling up from this blood...
And you must hear it, the echo from the abyss that guides our souls...
That one's voice, echoing from the darkness, gives power to the rage and curses of the dead...
All I feel is a murky, pitch-black, insane urge...
That is the very mercy that one grants us!
Not the false mercy the angels behind you preach. True mercy, which brings true salvation.
Steep yourself in that will, surrender to it, and you will understand...
Listening to any more of your mad words seems pointless...
Heh, true. Words will not tell us which of us is right.
I shall defeat you, bring you to your knees, and teach you that I am right.
Who the hell are you?
I'm taking back that Demon Stone.
Huh? Showing up out of nowhere and talking like that?
There's a polite way to ask a guy for something, ain't there?
...If you want to die, keep talking.
Whoa, scary. Some intensity you got there, pal. I don't wanna get hit by that big blade of yours.
Fine, it's just a favor I'm doing anyway... I'll hand it over nice and easy.
To the angel, that is.
You want it, don't ya? Truth be told.
Dark Clive
Clive... so you lost to your blood...
Can my words no longer reach you?
Ngh...
It is sad, but it seems we have no choice but to fight...
Why did you, a hero, become a vampire...?
Those eyes... they have already lost their light.
I did not want to fight you...
Witch of the Empire... I won't let you revive the Heavenly Dragon...
Hehehe, it's no use. The likes of you can't stop me.
I'll defeat you, Viper.
Big talk, angel's hero.
But I ain't dying before I get to see the end of the world!
You won't escape twice.
Yeah, I ain't running. Let's settle this right here.
I've come to defeat you and the Heavenly Dragon, and set right the chaos on the surface...
...There's no point listening to any more of your evil words...
Here I come!
Last Battle
Please... save his soul, save his life...
Clive!!
He believed in me, an angel, and fought for me. I will not let you use his soul or mine.
Last Battle (Hero Dies)
Hahahahaha, did you see that, you archangels?!
This is where your justice ends! Hahahaha!!!
Hahahahahahahahahaha!!
Clive
Rabbit 1
Rabbit 2
Rabbit 3
Dead Man
I gave the Demon Stone to that man, and Mother too...
I beat the villagers who got in my way, and I got food... Sonne, Mond, Stern, let's go home.
What? Who are you...?
So you're the one who did this to the villagers...
Shut up! It's their fault for getting in my way!
Sonne, Mond, Stern! Kill him!!
Hm? What're you, just a brat?
What the hell're you doing here?
So I just have to take this guy out? What a pain.
Hey, are you even listening to me?
Ugh, this is such a drag. Let's get it over with.
Why you little...!
Villager
Phew, having to deal with stuff like this is seriously such a pain.
Thank you, you saved us. That bandit had us at our wits' end.
Huh...!
Oh, um... it was nothing. Really. That little thing.
Please, come to our village. Everyone will give you a warm welcome.
Oh, no, you don't have to do that.
No, please, don't say that!
Sorry, I'm not good with that kind of thing...
Sorry!
Child+Vesta
Vesta
Ah! Vesta!
What? Is this bird yours, miss?
Yeah, that's right. I was looking for her.
It was kinda hurt, so I picked it up and fed it. But it doesn't look like a bad injury.
Thank you for helping her.
Oh my, did you find the owner?
Yeah, she says this owl is hers.
Well, isn't that nice.
What's your name, dear?
I-Irene...
Do you live around here? I don't recognize you.
I'm traveling, and Vesta here went missing on the way...
My, traveling alone at your age? That must be hard. I'm sure you have your reasons.
I know, come over to our place. There's food, too. How about it?
Oh, no, that's all right, really...
Nonsense, we all need help sometimes. Don't be shy, now!
Blind Mage
Imperial Warrior
Grand Master!
...A child?
Did you do this?
And if I did, what of it, young lady?
That's horrible... I won't forgive you!
Hehehe. A few filthy mages vanishing from this world is hardly anything to fly into a rage over.
Get away from him!
Such fire. Does this doddering old mage's life matter so much to you?
You monster... If you don't stop this, I really won't forgive you...!!
Hmph... there's no point swinging this sword of mine at a child.
Should you ever appear before me again, I will take you on then, young lady.
I leave the rest to you.
Warrior
Sir!
Master!
Who is it?
I'm Zig's granddaughter... My name is Irene.
Oh, I see...
Irene... listen. Fein, too... and this lodge, have fallen to the Empire...
No... Fein?
Yes...
The Empire, with Serenis working in its shadows, took the Demon Stone from here... She is already in the grip of evil...
Irene...
Please restore the pride of the mages that Zig, Fein and the Guild protected... I beg you...
...I grow bored.
My sword has drunk too much blood already... Enough playing with a little girl.
Another time, I'll make you my sword's prey, little witch.
Guild Master
But this lodge, too, has finally fallen to the Empire... The Empire took the Demon Stone from here...
The Demon Stone...?!
Irene... I must ask this of you, the child Zig left behind...
Protect the future of the Guild and its mages... I beg you...
It's Irene.
Oh... Irene...
Are you all right...?
Yes... it seems he forgot to finish me off...
But the Demon Stone has been taken.
The Demon Stone? The one from Delphinia?
Yes... that is what the stone is said to be.
There was an ill-omened prophecy, so we guarded the stone here...
Master, it's dangerous here. The imperial soldiers may come back.
Let's leave the town.
Yes... very well.
Grand Master, why on earth is the Empire doing all this...?
A legend from a thousand years ago... They plan to revive the Crimson Moon King.
It can't be...
No... Serenis, in the grip of evil, means to carry it out...
My sister...?!
Yes, the Guild has confirmed it. Serenis is at the imperial court...
No...
Surely you do not still think of Serenis as your sister...
Revived by a forbidden secret art, she is no longer your sister...
I... I can't give up. Serenis is... my sister...
Can't give up...
Fein said the same... But... the outcome will not change... Accept it, Irene.
I'm sorry, Grand Master.
No matter how many times I'm told, until I see my sister... no, until I bring her back... I won't give up...
...I see. Zig's blood... once you decide something, you won't listen...
I am heading to the lodge in Legrance. Come and visit me anytime.
Irene, you are still young... never throw your life away...
Yes... Grand Master.
Serenis has crossed into the Empire and is at its court... The Guild has confirmed it...
To think that tragedy would lead to this...
...I'll stop my sister.
You can't, Irene. That secret art... turns a person's body into an empty shell.
That is why it has been forbidden since ancient times.
She is no longer your sister, nor Fein's wife.
I... I can't give up. Serenis is my sister...
